授業概要
The course is designed to equip post-graduate science students with the skills they need to publicize their research at conferences. Students practise making poster and PowerPoint presentations about their own research, and learn how to write a conference abstract.

全体の教育目標
At the end of the course, students should be able to construct an abstract for a conference at which they will present their research.
個別の教育目標
Students should understand that communication is the bridge between research work and the wider world of science; that it is a skill, and like all skills can be developed with practise.
